Silver Baton.description: An indestructible silver scepter that can fire energy rays.

Red Cape.description: A high-collared cape that grants flight and invisibility.

Swashbuckler Armor.description: Ornate Atlantean plating that grants invulnerability.

Hydroflask.description: A vessel holding the water needed to awaken the God of Justice.

Kinesis Stone.description: An ancient relic granting the user powers of terrakinesis and aerokinesis.

Spectral Reins.description: Ethereal bindings used to control giant ancient machines.

Icarus Data.description: Critical data about the rogue planet's collision course.

Botan Rice Candy.description: A classic Japanese treat with an edible wrapper. It smells sweet, like fortune and nostalgia.
